title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Amos 9: no hiding place from Yahweh, the sifting of Israel among the nations, and the raising up of the fallen tent of David.

questions.text: Where was the Lord standing in what the speaker saw?
questions.explanation: He saw the Lord standing beside the altar, telling him to strike the tops of the pillars.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about those who climb up to heaven?
questions.explanation: Though they dig into Sheol his hand will take them, and though they climb up to heaven he will bring them down.

answers.text: He will leave them in peace there
He will bring them down from there
He will hide his face from them
He will send them to Sheol first

questions.text: What will Yahweh command against those hidden at the bottom of the sea?
questions.explanation: Though they are hidden from his sight at the bottom of the sea, he will command the serpent there, and it will bite them.

questions.text: What happens when the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, touches the land?
questions.explanation: He touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it mourn.

questions.text: From where does Yahweh say he brought up the Philistines?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether he has not brought up Israel out of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Syrians from Kir.

questions.text: Which house did Yahweh say he would not utterly destroy?
questions.explanation: His eyes are on the sinful kingdom and he will destroy it, except that he will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob.

questions.text: What is the sifting of the house of Israel among the nations compared with?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will raise up in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day he will raise up the fallen tent of David, close up its breaches and build it as in the days of old.

questions.text: What will drip from the mountains in the days that are coming?
questions.explanation: In the coming days the plowman will overtake the reaper, and sweet wine will drip from the mountains and flow from the hills.

questions.text: What does Yahweh promise about his people and their land at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: He will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of the land he has given them.

answers.text: They will share it with the nations
They will hold it for forty years
They will no more be plucked up out of it
They will leave it for a better land
